strengths: The overall layout is clean and modern, with good use of white space.
The typography is generally legible and appropriate for a mobile app.
The color palette is consistent and aligns with a professional healthcare app.
issues: The spacing between the category chips (جلية, أسنان, أطفال, باطنية, الكل) is inconsistent. Increase the spacing between them for better visual separation.
The 'لا توجد نتائج' (No results) message and the accompanying text are not well-aligned. The icon and text should be centered relative to each other.
The search bar placeholder text 'ابحث باسم الطبيب أو التخصص...' is too close to the search icon. Increase the padding on the left side of the placeholder text.

strengths: The overall layout is clean and organized, with clear sections for doctor information, description, fees, and scheduling.
The use of cards effectively separates different content blocks, improving readability.
The color palette is pleasant and consistent with a professional medical app.
issues: The text '١٥٠٠ ج.س' for the consultation fee is not aligned with the 'رسوم الكشف' title and appears to be floating. It should be aligned to the right under the title.
The spacing between the 'اختر اليوم المناسب' title and the day selection chips (الأربعاء, الاثنين, السبت) is a bit tight. Increase the spacing for better visual separation.
The font weight for the doctor's name 'د. أحمد خالد' is too light and could be bolder to create a stronger visual hierarchy and make it stand out more.
